title: Location Tracking & GPS Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request deletion of your location data from apps and services. Protect your GPS privacy with this ready-to-use letter format.
description: A comprehensive letter template to help you request the deletion of your location and GPS tracking data from companies. This template covers data access rights, deletion requests, and opt-out procedures for location-based services.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
Subject Line and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Location Data Access, Deletion, and Privacy Rights

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to exercise my privacy rights regarding the collection, storage, and use of my location and GPS tracking data by {{company_name}}. As a user of your {{service_type}}, I am concerned about how my precise location information is being collected, stored, shared, and used.

sections.heading: Data Access Request
sections.content:
Under applicable privacy laws including GDPR, CCPA, and other relevant regulations, I hereby request:

1. **Complete disclosure** of all location data you have collected about me, including:
   - GPS coordinates and timestamps
   - Location history and patterns
   - Geofencing data and triggers
   - Location-based advertising profiles
   - Data shared with third parties

2. **Details about data collection methods**, including:
   - When location tracking began
   - Frequency of data collection
   - Precision level of location data
   - Whether tracking continues when the app is closed

sections.heading: Data Deletion Request
sections.content:
I formally request the **complete deletion** of the following location-related data:

- All historical location data and GPS coordinates
- Location-based behavioral profiles and analytics
- Geolocation metadata from photos, posts, or uploads
- Location data shared with advertising networks or third parties
- Any derived data or insights based on my location patterns

Please confirm in writing that this data has been permanently deleted from all systems, including backups and third-party processors.

sections.heading: Opt-Out and Privacy Settings
sections.content:
Additionally, I request:

1. **Immediate cessation** of all location tracking activities related to my account
2. **Removal** from any location-based advertising or marketing programs
3. **Instructions** on how to permanently disable location services for your {{service_type}}
4. **Confirmation** that my location data will not be collected in the future without explicit consent

If your service requires location access to function, please provide clear information about the minimum data necessary and retention periods.

sections.heading: Third-Party Data Sharing
sections.content:
Please provide details about any third parties with whom you have shared my location data, including:

- Names of data brokers, advertising networks, or analytics companies
- Types of location data shared
- Legal basis for sharing
- Steps taken to request deletion from these third parties

I request that you contact these third parties to ensure my location data is also deleted from their systems.

sections.heading: Legal Compliance and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights pursuant to:
- General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Articles 15 and 17
- California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Sections 1798.100 and 1798.105
- Other applicable state and federal privacy laws

Please respond to this request within 30 days as required by law. If you cannot fulfill this request, please provide a detailed explanation of why and what alternative measures you can offer.
